Aisha Rana: Heads-up — I want to run a small experiment to reduce playbook noise from weak matches. We're calling it the 'eligibility sieve' (filters before playbook enqueue).
Ben Ortiz: love the name. what's the basic rule set?
Aisha Rana: short: require (1) >=2 distinct touchpoints in 30d AND (2) last_product_event within 30d OR health_score_bucket >= 2. If both false -> skip playbook trigger, mark for passive followup.
Carlos M.: that should cut a lot of churn. can you share the query? want to check edge cases (accounts with new seat adds but no product events).
Aisha Rana: copying the staging query below — quick and dirty but good for sampling:
```
SELECT account_id, last_product_event, touchpoint_count_30d, health_score_bucket
FROM crm_accounts_snapshot
WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '60 days';
-- sieve criteria: touchpoint_count_30d >= 2 OR last_product_event >= now() - interval '30 days' OR health_score_bucket >= 2
```
Samir Patel: two operational notes: (a) playbook automation currently reads the "eligible" flag at enqueue time, so this is a pre-filter change, (b) need to update the dry-run export that we send to AMs.
Olivia Chen: can we add an exception list for strategic accounts (manual override)? want to ensure not skipping renewals that are low-signal but high-value.
Aisha Rana: yes — add a simple whitelist table join `account_whitelist` for exceptions. will include in PR.
Ben Ortiz: what's the rollout plan? batch update or live? I'd prefer a canary on ~5% of accounts and watch: playbook sends, manual tasks opened, and healthscore drift.
Aisha Rana: agree. plan: 1) run query + annotate sample CSV for 5% cohort (staging) 2) run dry-run (no-op) for 24h to compare triggers 3) enable canary for 5% in prod for 48h 4) expand to 25% if metrics look good 5) global.
Carlos M.: metrics to observe: playbook-trigger-rate, manual task completion, reply rate from AMs, downstream SLA errors. Also check health_score_bucket distribution for sudden jumps.
Samir Patel: I'll add dashboards: cs.playbook.triggers.{sieve_canary,baseline}, cs.automation.false_suppression and cs.whitelist.overrides.
DevExBot: deploy checklist created: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/eligibility-sieve-checklist (permissions: cs-team).
Olivia Chen: timing? prefer quiet window — propose Sat 02:00 UTC for canary enable.
Aisha Rana: Sat 02:00 UTC works. I'll open the PR with SQL + join for whitelist + migration to add `sieve_enabled` toggle flag. @Samir please whip up migration rollback.
Samir Patel: will do. rollback plan: flip toggle off + re-enqueue skipped accounts via adhoc job `cs.reenqueue_skipped --since 24h`.
Ben Ortiz: quick review volunteers? @Carlos @Olivia?
Carlos M.: I'll review the SQL and whitelist join later today.
Olivia Chen: I'll review the playbook side and doc notes tomorrow morning. :+1:
Aisha Rana: thanks all — will post the PR and sample CSV in this thread.
DevExBot: Reminder scheduled: canary enable at 1739395200 (Sat 02:00 UTC).
